patch_description: Add a late-stage active-set repair batch. The smallest determinants in strong 11-point layouts are coupled: moving only one point often cannot improve one active triangle without worsening another. During the final quarter, this edit identifies all free points participating in near-active triples and proposes coordinated multi-point perturbations at several decreasing amplitudes. The incumbent remains in the candidate batch, so the existing monotone selection behavior is retained.
